items.exampleEn: Our mission is to help small shops sell online.
items.exampleZh: 我們的使命是幫助小商店在網路上賣東西。

items.sentenceEn: This drink contains a lot of sugar, so don't have too much.
items.sentenceZh: 這種飲料含很多糖，所以不要喝太多。

items.audioEn: Before the meeting, please remove the old posters and hang the new ones on the wall.

options: Take the posters down after the meeting.

items.sentenceEn: People tend to spend more money when they shop online.
items.sentenceZh: 人們在網路購物時往往會花比較多錢。

items.sentenceEn: Lay the papers flat on the table, please.

items.stemEn: Regular cleaning helps ____ the machine in good condition.
items.stemZh: 定期清潔有助於讓機器維持在良好狀態。

items.stemEn: The team's ____ is to deliver food to old people who live alone.
items.stemZh: 這個團隊的任務是送餐給獨居的老人。

items.passageEn: The bakery on Park Street has been in operation since 1980. The owner, Mrs. Wu, has one mission: to make bread the old way. Every morning, she lays the fresh bread on wooden shelves. Her bread contains no sugar, so it tends to taste a little plain, but many people love it. She works hard to maintain her old oven. Last year, she removed the old sign and hung a new one with her grandson's drawing on it.
items.passageZh: 公園街上的那家麵包店從 1980 年營業到現在。老闆吳太太只有一個使命：用傳統的方式做麵包。每天早上，她把剛出爐的麵包平放在木頭架子上。她的麵包不含糖，所以吃起來往往有點清淡，但很多人很喜歡。她很努力地保養她的舊烤箱。去年，她拿掉舊招牌，掛上一塊印著孫子畫作的新招牌。

questions.questionZh: 吳太太的麵包有什麼特色？

items.promptZh: 這份報告包含很多有用的資料。
referenceEn: This report contains a lot of useful information.
The report contains much useful information.
rubricZh: contain 表示「包含」，主詞是報告（第三人稱單數，動詞用 contains）
information 是不可數名詞，可用 a lot of、much 等

items.promptZh: 這裡的夏天往往又熱又多雨。
referenceEn: Summers here tend to be hot and rainy.
Summer here tends to be hot and rainy.
rubricZh: 用 tend to＋原形動詞表示「往往」（例如 tend to be；寫 are usually 也正確）
主詞與動詞單複數一致即可（例如 Summers here tend…、Summer here tends… 等）
